nvidia_openshell_raw.dataset_description: NVIDIA OpenShell OCSF events (network, HTTP, SSH, device configuration and base events) ingested via the HTTP Collector.

class_name.field_description: OCSF event class name (e.g. Network Activity, HTTP Activity).

activity_name.field_description: OCSF activity name describing the action performed in the event.

type_name.field_description: OCSF event type name (class name combined with activity).

severity.field_description: OCSF severity of the event (e.g. Informational, Medium, High).

metadata.field_description: OCSF metadata object: event UID, schema version and product details.

device.field_description: OCSF device object describing the host running the OpenShell supervisor.

container.field_description: OCSF container object describing the sandboxed workload (name, UID).

dst_endpoint.field_description: OCSF destination endpoint object (domain, IP, port).

proxy_endpoint.field_description: OCSF proxy endpoint object for the OpenShell network proxy (IP, port).

unmapped.field_description: OpenShell-specific attributes not covered by OCSF (mapping ID, normalized domain, policy hash).

state.field_description: State of the configuration or connection reported by the event.

action.field_description: OCSF action taken by the security control (e.g. Allowed, Denied).

disposition.field_description: OCSF disposition of the event as determined by the security control.

status_detail.field_description: Additional details about the event status or failure reason.

actor.field_description: OCSF actor object describing the process that initiated the activity.

firewall_rule.field_description: OCSF firewall rule object for the policy rule that matched (name, type).

http_request.field_description: OCSF HTTP request object (method, URL scheme, hostname, path, port).
